documents.subject: Payroll record and settlement status
documents.body:
Hello Casey Team05,

The payroll record for Meridian Ledger Labs, Inc. is PAY-003, dated 2025-03-31. The packet lists gross payroll of $438,000.00, withholding of $87,600.00, employer costs of $35,040.00, and net payroll of $350,400.00. Please confirm whether any external movement connected with this record has been confirmed. Under the settlement policy, only confirmed external movements are settled; proposals are not settlements. If an explanation or supporting context is missing, please provide it for review.

Regards,
Taylor Team06
